name: Advisory letter
d: Points out a gap and expects it fixed. No formal sanction.

name: Warning letter
d: Formal warning that further action follows if the gap is not fixed.

name: Compliance directive
d: Orders specific steps by a set date.

name: Monetary penalty
d: A fine under the regulation, with a payment deadline.

name: Restriction or suspension
d: Limits or suspends an activity or licence until the gap is fixed.

name: Referral
d: Refers the matter to another authority or to prosecution.
